values.note: 32 back-in single sites in the recreation.gov catalog, driveways 18-58 ft (53-58 ft at 11, 43-50 at 9, 28-38 at 11, one of 18). A few waterfront sites have river access.

values.note: 17 of the 32 sites are reservable on recreation.gov (or 1-877-444-6777) and 15 are first-come; recreation.gov sells the opening week (May 14-20 in 2027) as a first-come season. A reservation is held until noon the day after arrival. Recreation.gov's notices refer to a campground concessionaire and manager (facility line 906-767-1111).

note: Hiawatha NF campground (Munising Ranger District) in mature hardwoods between Irwin Lake and the Indian River, about 16 miles from Munising via M-28, Forest Highway 13 and Forest Road 2262. Sites range from heavily wooded and private to open; boat ramp at the campground (and at Fish Lake), an access point for the Indian River Canoe Trail; brook trout. The 9-mile Bruno's Run Trail passes through the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov + RIDB catalog: fees $26 (confirmed, 2027; FS page's $22 is stale), no hookups (confirmed), count changed 34 -> 32 with back-in driveways to 58 ft (new), vault toilets + potable water (confirmed), season May 15 - Sep 15 (new, FS 'Seasons of Use'; 'Site Closed' today is the seasonal close), reservable on recreation.gov (confirmed) with 15 first-come sites, no minimum. Access is paved FH-13 then 0.5-1 mi of FR 2262; the Hiawatha alerts page lists no closure for either. Phone (Munising RD 906-387-2512, the FS page's) matches. Note trimmed of field restatements.
